4600:
** σῐᾱγών**,
_Ionic dialect_ **σῐηγών**, όνος, ἡ, **jaw-bone, jaw**, {{LXX+5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “ἐπιδημίαι” 3.17.β, 5th c.BC: Sophocles Tragicus “Fragmenta” 112, 5th-6th c.BC: Aristophanes Comicus “Fragmenta” 287, “PCair.Zen.” 76.12 (3rd c.BC), LXX.Judg.15.14, +others}}; of an ox, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Cratinus Comicus 163}}; of a camel, probably in {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|“PLond.” 3.909 (a). 7 (2nd c.AD)}}; κινεῖται δὲ τοῖς.. ζῴοις ἅπασιν ἡ κάτωθεν σ., κτλ., {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Aristoteles Philosophus “Historia Animalium” 516a24, compare 492b22}}; **cheek**, {{NT+3rd c.BC+|3rd c.BC: Cercidas Iambographus 5.6, NT.Matt.5.39}}:—written **συαγών**, {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|“BGU” 100.5 (2nd c.AD),compare 2nd c.AD: Athenaeus Epigrammaticus 3.94f}}; also **σεαγών**, {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|“BGU” 153.17, 35 (2nd c.AD), “Sammelb.” 5167.11.}}
4605:
** Σῑδών**, ῶνος, ἡ,
{{Refs 8th c.BC+|“Sidon”, 8th c.BC: Odyssea Homerus Epicus “Odyssey” 15.425, 5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 2.116, etc.}}: hence _adjective_ **Σῑδόνιος**, α, ον, {{Refs 8th c.BC+|8th c.BC: Ilias Homerus Epicus “Illiad” 6.290, 4th-5th c.BC: Aeschylus Tragicus “Supplices” 122}}; later **Σιδώνιος**, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|4th-5th c.BC: Phrynichus Tragicus 9 (Lyric poetry), 5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 7.44, 5th c.BC: Sophocles Tragicus “Fragmenta” 909, 4th c.BC: Sopater Comicus 16, etc.}}; _feminine_ **Σιδωνιάς**, άδος, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus “Hel.” 1451 (Lyric poetry)}}:—**Σῐδόνες**, οἱ, **men of Sidon**, {{Refs 8th c.BC+|8th c.BC: Ilias Homerus Epicus “Illiad” 23.743}}; also **Σιδόνιοι**, {{Refs 8th c.BC+|8th c.BC: Odyssea Homerus Epicus “Odyssey” 4.84, 618; Σιδονίη (i.e. γῆ) 13.285. [ῐ in 8th c.BC: Ilias Homerus Epicus “Illiad” 23.743, probably in 4th c.BC: Sopater Comicus 16, elsewhere ῑ.]}}
4607:
** σῑκάριος** [ᾱ], ὁ,
= Latin _sicarius,_ {{NT+1st c.AD+|NT.Acts.21.38, 1st c.AD: Josephus Historicus “Antiquitates Judaicae” 20.8.10, +others}}
4608:
** σίκερα**, τό,
**fermented liquor, strong drink**, {{LXX+NT+2nd c.AD+|LXX.Lev.10.9, LXX.Isa.24.9, NT.Luke.1.15, 2nd c.AD: Galenus Medicus 19.693}}. (Cf. Hebrew **šēkār.**)
4609:
**Σίλας**, -α (accusative to BL, § 29, W-Schm., 74, -ᾶς, -ᾶ), ὁ (Aram. שׁאִילָא; see Dalman, _Gr._, 157.5),
**Silas **(called also Σιλουανός, which see): Act.15:22, 27 15:32, 34 15:40 16:19, 25 16:29 17:4, 10 17:14-15 18:5 †
(From Abbott-Smith. LSJ has no entry)
4610:
**Σιλουανός**
(in MSS also Σιλβανός, a form frequently in π.), -οῦ, ὁ,
**Silvanus, latinized name of Silas**: 2Co.1:19, 1Th.1:1, 2Th.1:1, 1Pe.5:12.†
(From Abbott-Smith. LSJ has no entry)
4611:
**Σιλωάμ** (indecl., but in FlJ, genitive, ᾶ, B.J., ii, 16, 2), ὁ (Heb. שִׁלֹחַ),
**Siloam **(see _DB_, iii, 515 f.): Luk.13:4, Jhn.9:7, 11.†
(From Abbott-Smith. LSJ has no entry)
4614:
**Σινά**
(-ᾶ, Rec.),
indecl. (but τὸ Σιναῖον, FlJ, _Ant._, iii, 5, 1; τὸ Σιναῖον ὄρος, ib. ii, 12, 1), τό
(Heb. סִינַי),
Sinai (Exo.19:11, al.): Act.7:30, 38, Gal.4:24-25†

4617:
** σινι-άζω**,
(σινίον) ={σήθω}, **sift, winnow,** {{NT+5th c.AD+|NT.Luke.22.31, 5th c.AD(?): Hesychius Legal icographus, 9th c.AD: Photius Legal icographus, etc., “Corpus Glossariorum Latinorum”}}
4618:
** σῑτ-ευτός**, ή, όν,
**fed up, fatted**, παῖδες {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Xenophon Historicus “Anabasis” 5.4.32}}; of beasts, {{NT+4th c.BC+|“PCair.Zen.” 350.4 (3rd c.BC), LXX.Judg.6.25 (codex A), 2nd c.BC: Polybius Historicus 38.8.7, NT.Luke.15.23, +others; σ. χήν 4th c.BC: Epigenes Comicus 2, “PGrad.” 2.9 (3rd c.BC, _plural_), “PCair.Zen.” 26 (a). 4 (3rd c.BC).}}
4619:
** σῑτ-ευτός**, ή, όν,
**fed up, fatted**, παῖδες {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Xenophon Historicus “Anabasis” 5.4.32}}; of beasts, {{NT+4th c.BC+|“PCair.Zen.” 350.4 (3rd c.BC), LXX.Judg.6.25 (codex A), 2nd c.BC: Polybius Historicus 38.8.7, NT.Luke.15.23, +others; σ. χήν 4th c.BC: Epigenes Comicus 2, “PGrad.” 2.9 (3rd c.BC, _plural_), “PCair.Zen.” 26 (a). 4 (3rd c.BC).}}
4620:
** σῑτομετρ-ία**, ἡ,
**measured allowance of corn, rations,** {{Refs 3rd c.BC+|3rd c.BC: Zenon Papyri du Caire 292.63 (2nd c.BC), 2nd c.BC: Polybius Historicus 1.68.9}}, **Mélanges Glotz** {{Refs 2nd c.BC+|904 (Iasos, 2nd c.BC), 1st c.BC: Diodorus Siculus Historicus 2.41, 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus “Cat.Ma.” 8, “OGI” 533.29 (from Ancyra), 2nd c.AD: Polyaenus Historicus 4.12.1}}: so **σῑτομέτρ-ιον**, τό, {{NT|NT.Luke.12.42}}; ἔπαρχος -μετρίου δήμου Ῥωμαίων, = Latin _praefectus annonae,_ {{Refs|Inscriptiones Graecae ad res Romanas pertinentes 3.667 (from Patara)}}; **σῑτομέτρ-μετρον**, τό, {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus 2.313b.}}
4624:
** σκανδαλ-ίζω**,
**cause to stumble, give offence** or **scandal to** any one, τινα {{NT|NT.Matt.5.29, 17.27, etc.}}:— _passive_, **to be made to stumble, take offence**, {{Refs|[prev. work] 26.33}}, etc.; ἔν τινι {{LXX+NT|LXX.Sir.9.5, +others, NT.Matt.11.6, 26.31, etc.}}
4629:
** σκέπ-ασμα**, ατος, τό,
**a covering**, τῶν σ. ὑποπετάσματα μὲν ἄλλα, περικαλύμματα δὲ ἕτερα {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Politicus” 279d}}; of a cap or shoe, {{Refs|[prev. author] “Lg.” 942d}}; of clothing generally, {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Aristoteles Philosophus “Politica” 1336a17; also ὄνυχες σ. τῶν ἀκρωτηρίων εἰσίν [prev. author] “PA” 687b24}}; **covering membrane**, {{Refs|[prev. author] “GA” 780b28}}; τὸ φύλλον περικαρπίου σ., in plants, {{Refs|[prev. author] “de An.” 412b2; οἰκία σ. ἐκ πλίνθων καὶ λίθων [prev. author] “Metaphorical” 1043a32.}}
4630:
**Σκευᾶς**, -ᾶ
**Sceva**: Act.19:14.†
(From Abbott-Smith. LSJ has no entry)
4644:
** σκληροτράχηλος** [ᾰ], ον,
**stiff-necked**, {{LXX+5th c.BC+|LXX.Exo.33.3, +others, 5th-4th c.BC: Aesopus Fabularum Scriptor 318, NT.Act.7.51}}; compare σκληραύχην:—hence **σκληροτρᾰχηλέω**, [{{Refs 5th c.AD+|5th c.AD(?): Hesychius Legal icographus see at {Τελχιτένοντες}, Phot. see at {Τελχιταίνει}, “Etymologicum Magnum” 751.36.}}]
4654:
** σκοτίζω**,
**make dark**, τὸν θεὸν τὸν φωτίζοντα καὶ σκοτίζοντα τὸν κόσμον {{Refs 3rd c.AD+|“Tab.Defix.Aud.” 242.13 (Carthage, 3rd c.AD)}}; **get in the light of**, ἐνέργειαν {{Refs 1st c.BC+|2nd c.AD: Galenus Medicus 18(2).698: _metaphorically_, λαβὼν δισσὰς ἐσκότισας χάριτας Ἀρχ.Δελτ. 11.57 (from Larissa), compare 1st c.BC: Dionysius Halicarnassensis “de Thucydide” 33, 4th c.AD: Themistius Sophista “Orationes” 11.153a}}; **stupefy**, σκορπίους {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st c.AD: Dioscorides (Dioscurides) Medicus “Eup.” 2.133}}:—_passive_, **to be darkened**, {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus 2.1120e}}; **to be blinded**, σκοτισθήτωσαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτῶν {{LXX+NT|LXX.Psa.68(69).24; τῇ διανοίᾳ NT.Eph.4.18 (variant); χολῇ τὰς φρένας 12th c.AD: Tzetzes, Joannes Grammaticus “Historiarum variarum chiliades” 8.929}}; **to be dizzy**, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-4th c.BC: Aesopus Fabularum Scriptor 247b.}}
4656:
** σκοτ-όω**,
**darken, blind**, σκοτώσω βλέφαρα καὶ δεδορκότα {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Sophocles Tragicus “Ajax” 85}}; **stupefy**, {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|2nd c.AD: Soranus Medicus 1.125 (_active_ and _passive_)}}; **make dizzy**, τὰς ὄψεις {{NT|Philo Byzantius Paradoxographus “de Septem Miraculis” 2.5: _metaphorically_, NT.Eph.4.18}}:—_passive_, **to be in darkness, suffer from vertigo**, like{σκοτοδινιάω}, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th-6th c.BC: Plato Philosophus “Respublica” 518a, “Prt.” 339e, “Tht.” 209e, 4th-3rd c.BC: Theophrastus Philosophus “de Vertigine” 7, 2nd c.BC: Polybius Historicus 10.13.8}}; ἕλμινθες -ωθεῖσαι **stupefied**, {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st c.AD: Herodotus Medicus cited in 6th c.AD: Aëtius Medicus 9.37, compare 2nd c.AD: Galenus Medicus 16.657.}}
4661:
** σκῦλον**, τό,
mostly in _plural_ σκῦλα, **arms stripped off a slain enemy, spoils**, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Sophocles Tragicus “Philoctetes” 1428, 1431, 5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus “Iphigenia Taurica” 74, “El.” 7, 1000, 5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 4.134, “SIG” 61 (Olympia, 5th c.BC)}}; σκῦλα γράφειν to write one's name on **arms gained as spoils**, which were then dedicated to a deity, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus “Phoenissae” 574; σκῦλ᾽ ἔδειξα Βακχίῳ [prev. author] “Cyc.” 9, compare 5th c.BC: Thucydides Historicus 2.13, 3.57}}: less frequently in _singular_, **booty, spoil, prey**, σκῦλον οἰωνοῖσιν {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus “Electra” 897, compare “Rh.” 620, 1st-2nd c.AD: Dio Chrysostomus Sophista 64.24; τὰς πτέρυγας.. τῇ Νίκῃ φορεῖν ἔδοσαν,.. σκῦλον ἀπὸ τῶν πολεμίων 4th c.BC: Aristopho Comicus 11.9; σκῦλον τὴν ὑπατείαν φέρεσθαι 1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus “Marius” 9.}}
4667:
** Σμύρνα**,
_Ionic dialect_ **Σμύρ-νη**, ἡ, {{Refs 8th c.BC+|“Smyrna”, in Ionia, 8th c.BC: Homerus Epicus “Epigrammata” 4.6, 6th c.BC: Mimnermus Lyricus 9.6}} (where it is called Aeolic,{{Refs 5th c.BC+|compare 5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 1.149)}}:—**Σμυρναῖος**, α, ον, **of Smyrna**, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Pindarus Lyricus “Fragmenta.” 204}}; **Σμυρναϊκός**, ή, όν, {{Refs 1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Dorio Rerum Naturalium Scriptor cited in 2nd c.AD: Athenaeus Epigrammaticus 7.319d, etc.}}— In Inscrr. and Coins frequently written **Ζμύρνα**, **Ζμυρναῖος**, {{Refs|“IG” 3.128.14, “IGRom.” 4.1545 (from Erythrae), Head “Hist.Num.” p.593.}}
4668:
** Σμύρνα**,
_Ionic dialect_ **Σμύρ-νη**, ἡ, {{Refs 8th c.BC+|“Smyrna”, in Ionia, 8th c.BC: Homerus Epicus “Epigrammata” 4.6, 6th c.BC: Mimnermus Lyricus 9.6}} (where it is called Aeolic,{{Refs 5th c.BC+|compare 5th c.BC: Herodotus Historicus 1.149)}}:—**Σμυρναῖος**, α, ον, **of Smyrna**, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Pindarus Lyricus “Fragmenta.” 204}}; **Σμυρναϊκός**, ή, όν, {{Refs 1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Dorio Rerum Naturalium Scriptor cited in 2nd c.AD: Athenaeus Epigrammaticus 7.319d, etc.}}— In Inscrr. and Coins frequently written **Ζμύρνα**, **Ζμυρναῖος**, {{Refs|“IG” 3.128.14, “IGRom.” 4.1545 (from Erythrae), Head “Hist.Num.” p.593.}}
4670:
**Σόδομα**, -ων, τά (Heb. סְדֹם),
Sodom (Gen.13:10, 12, al.): Mat.10:15 11:23-24 Luk.10:12 17:29, Rom.9:29" (LXX), 2Pe.2:6, Ju 7, Rev.11:8.†
(From Abbott-Smith. LSJ has no entry)
4672:
**Σολομών**, -ῶνος (so prop., but Rec. has frequently -ῶν, -ῶντος, as also WH in Act.3:11 5:12; in Act.7:47 T has Σαλωμών, as LXX freq., indecl.; see B1., § 10, 1; Tdf., Prol., 104, 119; WH, _App._, 158), ὁ (Heb. שְׁלֹמֹה),
**Solomon**: Mat.1:6-7 6:29 12:42, Luk.11:31 12:27, Jhn.10:23, Act.3:11 5:12 7:47.†
(From Abbott-Smith. LSJ has no entry)
4676:
** σουδάριον**, τό,
= Latin _sudārium, towel, napkin,_ {{NT+2nd c.AD+|NT.Luke.19.20, NT.John.11.44, “CPR” 1.27.7 (2nd c.AD), “Supp.epigram” 7.417 (from Dura), 2nd c.AD(?): Pollianus Epigrammaticus 7.71; σ. ὁλόλιτον “PMag.Ost.” 1.269 (4th c.AD).}}
4677:
**Σουσάννα**, -ης
(cf. Dan LXX TH Su, inscr., 2, 7, al.)
**Susanna**: Luk.8:3.†
(From Abbott-Smith. LSJ has no entry)
4681:
**Σπανία**, -ας, ἡ
(= cl. Ἑσπερία or Ἰβηρία; late writers adopted the Roman name, Ἱσπανία (1Ma.8:3) or Σ. as here),
**Spain**: Rom.15:24, 28.†
(From Abbott-Smith. LSJ has no entry)
4683:
** σπαργᾰν-όω**,
= σπάργω, **wrap in** σπάργανα (whether 1.1 or 1.2), σπαργανώσαντες πέπλοις [τὸν παῖδα] {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Euripides Tragicus “Ion” 955}}; **swathe**, {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Aristoteles Philosophus “Historia Animalium” 584b4, 2nd c.AD: Soranus Medicus 1.83, +others: _metaphorically_, 4th-3rd c.BC: Clearchus Historicus “fragment” 26}}; θρίοισι ταύτην (i.e. τὴν ἀμίαν) ἐσπαργάνωσα {{Refs 4th c.BC+|4th c.BC: Sotades Comicus 1.28}}; ἀχύροις σ. [τὴν χιόνα] {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus 2.691c}}:—_passive_, {{NT+5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “Aër.” 20, “Fract.” 22; βρέφος ἐσπαργανωμένον NT.Luke.2.12.}}
4684:
** σπᾰτᾰλ-άω**,
**live softly** or **in excessive comfort** or **indulgence**, {{NT+2nd c.BC+|2nd c.BC: Polybius Historicus 36.17.7, “IG” 14.2002 (from Rome), LXX.Sir.21.15, NT.1Tim.5.6, NT.Jam.5.5}}; τὰ σπαταλῶντα τῶν παιδίων **spoilt** children, {{Refs 4th c.BC+|Theano in 4th-5th c.BC: Pythagoras Philosophus “Ep.” 4.4, compare 4th c.BC: Diogenes Cynicus Philosophus “Epistulae - Epistolographi” 28.7.}}
4695:
** σπῐλ-όω**,
**stain, soil**, {{NT+1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Dionysius Halicarnassensis 9.6, NT.Jam.3.6}}; **mark**, λευκαῖς (with leucodermia) {{Refs|“Catalogus Codicum Astrologorum” 8(4).174:}} —_passive_, εἶδος σπιλωθὲν χρώμασι, of a painting, {{LXX|LXX.Wis.15.4}}: _perfect_ _participle_ ἐσπιλωμένος **soiled, Ep. Jud.** {{Refs 2nd c.AD+|23, compare 2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “Am.” 15}}: simply, **to be marked**, {{Refs 3rd c.AD+|3rd c.AD: Heliodorus Scriptor Eroticus 10.15.}}
4696:
** σπίλος** [ῐ], ὁ,
**B** **spot, fleck, blemish**, {{Refs 5th c.BC+|5th c.BC: Hippocrates Medicus “ἐπιστολαί” 16, 1st c.BC: Dorio Rerum Naturalium Scriptor cited in 2nd c.AD: Athenaeus Epigrammaticus 7.297c; σ. αἵματος 1st c.AD: Josephus Historicus “Antiquitates Judaicae” 13.11.3 (_plural_)}}; on the moon, {{Refs 1st c.AD+|1st-2nd c.AD: Plutarchus Biographus et Philosophus 2.921f; on the face or body, 1st c.AD: Dioscorides (Dioscurides) Medicus 1.33, 2nd c.AD: Lucianus Sophista “Am.” 15, 2nd c.AD: Artemidorus Daldianus Onirocriticus 5.67, 4th c.AD: Libanius Sophista “Declamationes” 26.19, “Geoponica” 12.26.2}}: _metaphorically_, **stain** of impurity or vice, {{NT+4th c.AD+|Lysis Philosophus cited in 4th c.AD: Iamblichus Philosophus “de vita Pythagorica” 17.76, NT.Eph.5.27}}; of persons, {{NT+1st c.BC+|1st c.BC: Dionysius Halicarnassensis 4.24 (conjecture), NT.2Pet.2.13. (_Attic dialect_ use κηλίς _accusative_ to 2nd c.AD: Phrynichus Atticista 21.) [σπῖλος}} Hdn.Gr.2.920; but ῐ in the equivalent σπιλάς (B) and in the _compound_ ἄσπιλος.]
